references.text: Jesus commands the disciples to go out and make disciples of all nations, which reflects the mission to spread the gospel to all nations in Matthew 24:14.
Similar to Jesus' words in Matthew 24:14 about the gospel being preached to all nations before the end comes.
Luke presents a similar theme to Matthew 24:14, where witness to all nations is necessary before the end times.
Acts 1:8 emphasizes Jesus' command to be witnesses 'to the ends of the earth', which corresponds with the message in Matthew 24:14 about the gospel being preached throughout the world.

Revelation 14:6 speaks of an angel proclaiming an eternal gospel to all who live on the earth, to every nation, tribe, language and people, reflecting the theme in Matthew 24:14 of worldwide evangelism before the end times.
